preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100,000.
For each test case, the number of residents n and the number of friendship pairs m must satisfy 1 ≤ n ≤ m ≤ 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n for a_i, b_i in friendships)
preconditions.description: All friendship pairs (a_i, b_i) must have valid indices within the range of residents and cats.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'No' or (stdout.startswith('Yes') and len(jury) + len(contestants) == n)
postconditions.description: If it's impossible to select the jury and contestants, output 'No'. Otherwise, output 'Yes' followed by the counts of jury and contestants summing to n.
There must be at least one jury member and one contestant.

postconditions.expression: all(j not in contestants for j in jury)
postconditions.description: Every jury member must not be acquainted with any contestant.
